top_signals.title: US Natural Gas Surges as Hotter Outlooks Trigger Short-Covering
top_signals.summary: US natural gas futures rose by the most in more than two months as an unusually large swing in weather forecasts triggered a wave of short-covering among money managers who were the most bearish on gas since 2020.
